title: Isn't he wonderful

lines.text: Eyes have seen, ears have heard,

chords:
[Verse]
Isn't He [D]wonderful [G]wonderful, [D]wonderful?
Isn't [D]Jesus my [A]Lord [D]wonderful?
[D]Eyes have seen, [G]ears have heard,
[D]it's recorded in [A]God's Word;
Isn't Jesus my Lord wonderful?
lyrics:
[Verse]
Isn't He wonderful wonderful, wonderful?
Isn't Jesus my Lord wonderful?
Eyes have seen, ears have heard,
it's recorded in God's Word;
Isn't Jesus my Lord wonderful?
